summary: Representative pancreatic tissue with polarized acini, centroacinar duct origins, successive duct levels and intermingled endocrine cell types associated with capillaries. Exocrine secretion enters a duct lumen; endocrine secretion enters blood. Views expose these relationships progressively. Geometry and synchronized animation require final-machine validation before anatomical acceptance.
scale_note: Representative 1 mm-wide teaching block; 1 model unit = 0.5 mm. The selected baseline already enlarges acinar envelopes and sampling pitch 1.8x, endocrine-cell sampling pitch 1.85x and acinar nuclear maximum radius 1.4x. Preserve and report these inherited schematic factors unless the refined source deliberately changes them. Displayed cell counts, granule counts and capillary paths are sampled; no morphometric inference. Camera zoom enlarges the whole view without changing anatomy. Flow markers and animation time are schematic.

V1.title: Specimen cutaway
V1.description: Representative pancreatic tissue; exocrine acini surround pale endocrine islets. Sectioned surfaces are specimen cuts. Flow cues are hidden at rest.

V2.title: Acinar polarity and duct origin
V2.description: Basal nuclei and apical cytoplasm remain together around a lumen with centroacinar duct cells. Use a section and camera zoom to inspect one source-owned acinus.

V3.title: Duct hierarchy
V3.description: Centroacinar origin inside a retained translucent acinar host boundary and lumen → intercalated → intralobular → interlobular duct. Septal tissue supplies context. Exposed boundary outlets are specimen cuts.

V4.title: Human islet and exchange
V4.description: Sampled intermingled endocrine cells and their capillary relationship; this is one schematic human pattern, not a universal cellular distribution.

V5.title: Supply, exchange and drainage
V5.description: Follow artery, representative exchange beds and venous drainage. Junctions and boundary cuts must be distinguished in the refined source.

V6.title: Exocrine delivery
V6.description: Play: granules release into the acinar lumen; pancreatic juice travels in the duct lumen. Duct walls and owner cells stay visible.

V7.title: Endocrine delivery
V7.description: Play: beta cells release insulin into islet capillaries. Blood exit is distinct from duct drainage.

V8.title: Connective-tissue interfaces
V8.description: Inspect supporting tissue from both sides, including intentionally exposed cut boundaries and fitted passages.

application_notes.part_names: Final canonical names, exact Unicode en dashes. Remap aliases only for lesson compatibility. No core/mantle claim should be visible in labels or summary.
application_notes.opacity: Lead sets gland.bulk=False for cell compartments and ducts; connective support retains bulk=True. Native slider therefore controls supporting tissue only. Native default still sets CT support to 50%; final output-only adapter explicitly sets 100 for opening, with matching slider/readout. Host membranes and lumen remain teaching overlays at declared source alpha.
application_notes.camera_calibration: All camera records are supplied, real native fields. Whole-block/islet poses follow bounded source coordinates but have not been visually calibrated. V2 needs source-owned representative anchor to frame one acinus; avoid arbitrary claimed close-up targets.
application_notes.representative_anchor: update_representative_camera accepts source-probe transformed representative_acinus {centre:[x,y,z],radius:positive}, with radius the final world envelope radius. No array loading in helper. Call before registration and write updated settings into output only.
